key_insight: ScAn-Bench introduces the first systematic benchmark for evaluating how scaling laws and scaling prescriptions are derived across language and vision-language models.
engineering_relevance: It helps ML engineers choose more reliable scaling-analysis methods when deciding how to grow models, data, and training settings for foundation models.
method: Build surrogate benchmarks ScAn-Bench-LLM and ScAn-Bench-VLM from checkpoint pipelines.
Evaluate both data acquisition strategies and extrapolation methods used in scaling analysis.
Compare methodology across different modalities to expose blind spots in current practice.
evidence_signal: The benchmarks are built from 4,524 language-model checkpoints and 8,024 vision-language model checkpoints, enabling the first systematic evaluation across modalities.
watch_item: Results may depend on how well the surrogate benchmarks reflect real training dynamics, so benchmark fidelity should be checked before generalizing conclusions.
